supervision: all whole flat-layout train rows; no derived character annotations
augment: 2.5 percent scale and shear conditioned by style latent
advances: learned positive token advances; explicit spaces
singleton_loss: ordered stroke coordinates, mask BCE and width
sampling: 19 label-balanced complete anchor rows then one complete flat row; all streams cycle without omission
parent: compatible prefix-count train-only head weights, or new head; sequence weights may warm-start
vertical_composition: shared row baseline and cap/x-height/descender metrics; no inferred stroke annotations
strong_anchor_guard: open-path supplied singleton zero remains weak whole-row supervision, never promoted to strong ordered anchor
curve_output: ordered learned points interpolated with smooth cubic tangents
separated_rows: explicitly spaced practice uses uniform cell positions and learned relative ink width; ordinary words use proportional advances
conditional_bias: 600 learned logits per token; no source trajectories
refinement: last 30 percent: freeze shared decoder, alternate token-specific bias updates from complete source rows
coordinates: canonical em glyph width and shared vertical metrics; layout advances never scale glyph geometry
shape_loss: bidirectional point-set distance over four soft stroke candidates, weight 2
